control.acknowledgement: every fresh launcher incarnation at desired revision; never a load-balanced URL

apiOnly.privateOriginPolicy: exact RFC1918/ULA origins explicitly opted in; loopback and metadata always rejected
apiOnly.cloudProof: exact provider project, environment, image/SDK/builtin/codec inventory and real content-hashed acceptance artifacts; no VERIFIED boolean

readyRequires: original raft and envelope manifest preserved

dataPosture.postgresql: One fenced writable primary; provider-managed promotion and measured committed-write durability required. Single-node fixture is NOT HA. No RPO=0 claim.
dataPosture.redis: AOF everysec fixture is not zero-loss durability. Missing raw form values remain lost/unconfirmed, never reconstruct or ACK without encrypted checkpoint consumption.
dataPosture.openbao: Portable availability uses the SAME static seal bytes and existing key ID plus original raft data/KEK/DEKs. No reinitialization or replacement key can decrypt old ciphertext.
dataPosture.outage: Withdraw admission and fail closed when current SQL, Redis requirements, keyring, compatibility or OpenBao readiness cannot be proven. No second independent database/Bao master.

cutover.everyEnable: actual approved immutable first artifact or retained same first attestation, current image/media/key/DB proof and current zero legacy census; resume/rollback never bypass or repeat first rotation
cutover.localOssAcceptance: ordinary enabling remains blocked by unproven external/cutover proof; local control/data/crypto observations never prove Cloud fencing or two-pool HA activation
cutover.credentialRotationProof: explicit expiring owner-only approval, each exposed credential class revoked and replaced, old credential denied, replacement accepted, actual redacted content-hashed provider receipts; process exit zero alone is unproven
cutover.laterRollback: only exact protocol/SDKpatch/builtin/codec compatible immutable HA images
